question:
Which of the following figures represents Mendeléev's Periodic Table that was published in a German journal in 1872?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc7153ca276834fd7be94a56b0a3adcee92c830dd8992af42c789dd159a91348.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**c**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mendeleev's Periodic Table, published in 1872, was one of the first comprehensive arrangements of the known elements based on their properties and atomic masses. 
 
• **Key Features of Mendeleev's Periodic Table:**
 
 
• **Groups and Periods:**
 
 
• The table was arranged into groups (columns) and periods (rows).
 
• There were 8 groups (I to VIII) initially, though the main groups recognized were I to VII, with the 8th group being added later for transition elements.
 
• Periods ranged from 1 to 6.
 
 
 
• **Gaps for Unknown Elements:**
 
 
• Mendeleev left gaps in his table for elements that had not yet been discovered, predicting their existence and properties based on periodic trends.
 
 
 
• **Periodic Law:**
 
 
• The elements were arranged in order of increasing atomic mass, with elements with similar properties placed in the same group.
 
 
 
 
 
• Figure (c) shows groups I to VIII and periods are labeled from 1 to 6. Hence the correct answer is option 1- c.
